description: Mothership Hunt: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: A rogue machine mothership, the {target}, is drifting through {system} and pouring out drones. {client} wants it dead before it reaches {station}. Fighters will come out of it as long as it lives. Reach it, kill it and expect company.
Hunt the {target}. It is a mothership, big and quiet, and the drones come from inside it. Kill it and the swarm loses its source.
The {target} is the source. Drones come from it in waves. Fly in, break it and leave before the drones stop being the problem.
success: The {target} breaks and the drones go inert in the dark. {client} pays {captain} and files the wreckage as classified.
The mothership is dead. {client} pays the full fee and does not say what it expects to find in the wreckage.
The {target} dies. {client} pays and asks you not to describe what came out of it.
failure: The {target} survives and the drones keep coming. {client} pays nothing.
You are pushed out. The mothership goes on its way. {client} says it will wait for a better plan.
radio-mothership: There is the {target}. It is big and not talking to anyone.
Contact. It is the mothership. Four drones on guard.
{target} found. It is drifting and it is hungry.
radio-pour: The {target} is launching. A lot of drones. Keep pressing.
Drones in the lane. They are coming out in tens.
The mothership is pouring them out. Kill them or kill the source.
radio-flood: Another flood, left. Do not let them go for the engines.
Drones. More drones. The {target} is not stopping.
Heavy contacts with the drones. Stay in motion.
radio-guard: Two machine frigates have woken. They are heading for you.
Frigate-class machines, right. They guard the {target}.
The mothership has defenders. Two big ones.
